{{Top|leg}}
A '''smoke snake''' was a species found in the city of [[Rhol Yan]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kalimahr/Legends|Kalimahr]]. They lived underground but could be drawn from their abode by the religious meditations of [[Cathar/Legends|Cathars]], which they would dance to in a slow, hypnotic pattern.
